sources.title: loom-ai-org/lfm2-350m-monolithic-loom · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: LFM2-350M (monolithic export) Liquid AI's LFM2-350M hybrid conv/attention LM, exported as a single fused graph. This is a loom.cpp export: a single self-describing GGUF that carries its own graph topologies, tokenizer (if any) and driver script, produced by loom-exporter.

sources.title: LiquidAI/LFM2-350M · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: A newer version of this model is available: LiquidAI/LFM2.5-350M

sources.title: LFM2-350M - Liquid Docs
sources.snippet: LFM2-350M is Liquid AI's smallest text model, designed for edge devices with strict memory and compute constraints. Delivers surprisingly strong performance for its size, making it ideal for low-latency applications.

sources.title: LFM2.5-350M: No Size Left Behind | Blog | Liquid AI
sources.snippet: Today, we're releasing LFM2.5-350M, an improved version of our 350M model with additional pre-training (from 10T to 28T tokens) and large-scale reinforcement learning. Built on the LFM2 architecture, it delivers exceptionally fast inference and runs everywhere, from cloud GPUs to cheap CPUs.

sources.title: Introducing LFM2: The Fastest On-Device Foundation Models on the Market ...
sources.snippet: Today, we release LFM2, a new class of Liquid Foundation Models (LFMs) that sets a new standard in quality, speed, and memory efficiency for on-device deployment. Built on a hybrid architecture, LFM2 delivers 200% faster decode and prefill performance than Qwen3 and Gemma 3 on CPU.
